# Assumptions: crepitus

2 confirmed · 8 assumed · 1 open

## Confirmed (2)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cohort.column` | `V00COHORT` | Enrollees codebook: 1 Progression (1,390), 2 Incidence (3,284), 3 Non-exposed control (122) | The OAI enrollment subcohorts; person-level and fixed at baseline. Not the same as an outcome-based incident or progression definition, which this analysis reports separately by knee. |
| `incident_soa.definition` | `KL >= 2 and frequent knee pain at the same visit` | Lo 2018 (Arthritis Care Res 70:53) abstract: symptomatic OA = frequent symptoms and tibiofemoral KL >= 2 | At risk = native knees without baseline symptomatic OA and with baseline KL and frequent pain recorded. The paper's cohort was person-level and right-knee-oriented in its ACR abstract; this table is knee-level, so counts are not expected to equal the paper's 3,495 participants. |

| `progression.risk_kl` | `2-3` (choices: 2-3, 1-3) | No consensus; docs/reference/oai-progression-definition-crosswalk.md section 1 | KL progression needs a baseline grade that can still worsen (KL 4 cannot) and, for most definitions, existing radiographic OA.
